transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

For the past seven months, I've had this overwhelming surge of energy where I feel incredibly high and happy, but then I'll suddenly get extremely irritated by the smallest things. I just can't seem to sit still or stop moving, and I feel this constant need to keep doing things. It's like my mind and body are running at a hundred miles an hour!
During these periods of high energy, have you ever had to be hospitalized, or did your behavior become so extreme that it caused significant problems at work or in your relationships?
No, I've never been hospitalized for this. As for my work or relationships, I'm not really sure and haven't thought about it much, since I've just been so focused on keeping busy.
During these high-energy periods, have you ever experienced things that others couldn't see or hear, or held beliefs that others found strange or impossible?

Yes, when my energy is super high, I hear voices and see things that others can't, and I truly believe I have special powers or that people are targeting me. These strange experiences only ever happen during those times when my energy is through the roof.
